name: Algebraic Tie-Breaker
description: Replaces the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with a mathematical equivalent: minimizing a weighted sum V = sum(b_i * 4^{n-i}). This forces the model to mathematically deduce that the highest power dominates and thus the first valid solution found via ascending-order DFS is the global minimum. Models that fail to recognize this equivalence will write exhaustive search algorithms that track a minimum V, which will Time Limit Exceed (TLE) on hard instances.
